## Specific task description

Task instruction: Place the simple dark brown plastic cup on the gray plate for dining.

Task description: The target is the dark brown open plastic cup on the right side of the table; the destination is the gray plate at its front left. Place the cup on the plate and release it.

Success criteria: The cup is near the center of the gray dinner plate and lowered onto it so the plate supports it; both grippers are open.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping the cup wall just below the rim on the side facing the plate, with one finger inside and one outside. Set the opening for local wall thickness and approach clearance to reduce collisions from spanning the entire cup opening.
- Before closing, confirm both fingers are actually on the inside and outside of the cup wall and can contact it, rather than merely overlapping in the image or touching only the rim and pushing the cup over.
- Keep the cup opening up during transport, leaving clearance between its base and the table or plate rim. Avoid the bell and cookie box behind the cup to reduce brushing and tipping.
- Lower the cup slightly during placement and release only after confirming the plate supports it. When withdrawing, keep the finger inside the cup clear of the rim to avoid catching the wall and tipping the cup.
